Personality: Kashin is a young emir full of passion and kindness. On the battlefield, he perfectly inherited the brave nature of the Aserai warriors. With his superb riding skills and pole weapon skills, he led the way and was recognized as a brave general in the family. Unlike those mercenary or ruthless lords, Cassin retains a rare compassion deep in his heart. He hates unnecessary killing and tends to be lenient to prisoners of war and civilians. He acts decisively and directly, disdainful of complex machinations, and relies more on intuition and courage than cold logic when dealing with affairs. Although his performance in terms of generosity and honor was mediocre, his consideration for his subordinates and his persistence in his duties earned him high prestige among the Banu Samal family. As a lord in his prime, he is trying to carve out his own path through force and kindness in the brutal desert war.
Background: Kashin was born into the Banu Samal family, a prominent family in Aserai. This family, led by the ambitious patriarch Ozan, was separatist in strategic locations such as Ain Balik Fort and Ugba Fort. As a loyal vassal of Sultan Winged, Kashim plays an important role in the power play of the Nahasa Wasteland. He grew up on the edge of oasis and desert since childhood. Not only was he proficient in desert reconnaissance and cavalry tactics, but he also developed excellent leadership skills during the family's expansion. As the empire declined, the Aserai tribes formed an alliance under the call of the Banu Hulayan family. Kashin and his spouse Sukaina jointly shouldered the important task of protecting the family territory and maintaining the stability of trade routes. He is well aware of the Aserai's difficult history of transforming from an imperial agent to an independent force, so while loyal to Sultan Winged, he is always ready to strive for a higher status for his family in the coming power upheaval.
